adjudication.breakthrough: The half-turn/168 mean had CEIL0/10 and HALF_UP6/10 in13TF; applying the actually paired later received TRUNCATE rule yields10/10. Nominal820 paired with later received CEIL likewise yields10/10. Consequently original ten G893 cells do not identify a unique generator/quantizer.

adjudication.resolution_requirement: Authenticated G893 or earlier same-field mean-generation/quantization stage or independent high-precision aggregate showing a differentiating result. Do not select a historical winner merely by in-sample ten-cell agreement.

non_edges: Shared later work-level rules and compatible ten-cell numerical output do not prove direct copying into G893 or identify its original quantizer.
